text.div:
SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD

  • Start tiotropium-olodaterol 2.5/2.5 mcg soft mist inhaler, two inhalations each morning, keep albuterol as needed, and teach and check inhaler technique at every visit; no inhaled corticosteroid while there are no exacerbations and blood eosinophils are below 300 per microliter
  • Pulmonology consultation to confirm the GOLD grade and group, review the inhaler choice and the place of an inhaled corticosteroid, assess oxygen need at rest and on exertion, interpret the alpha-1 antitrypsin result, and advise on pulmonary rehabilitation and lung cancer screening
  • Outpatient pulmonary rehabilitation (mMRC 2 or more, GOLD 2 to 4), with a 6-minute walk test at entry and exit and a home exercise plan afterwards
  • At every visit: CAT, mMRC, exacerbations in the past 12 months, GOLD group, pulse oximetry, smoking status, BMI, and inhaler technique. Spirometry at diagnosis and at least yearly; alpha-1 antitrypsin once; blood eosinophils at baseline and before any change in inhaled corticosteroid; arterial blood gas only if resting saturation is 92 percent or less; long-term oxygen only for resting saturation of 88 percent or less confirmed twice at least three weeks apart; ECG and cardiovascular risk at baseline
  • Written COPD action plan: what an exacerbation looks like (more breathlessness, more or discolored sputum), when to use extra albuterol, and when to call the clinic the same day or go to emergency care
  • Lung cancer screening reviewed and not offered: he quit smoking more than 15 years ago, so he does not meet the USPSTF criteria despite more than 20 pack-years
  • Vaccines for COPD: yearly influenza (high dose at 65 and older), PCV20 once, RSV once at 75 and older, COVID-19 by CDC guidance, Tdap every ten years, and recombinant zoster
  • Comorbidity and mood screening at intake and yearly (depression, anxiety, cardiovascular disease, osteoporosis, reflux, sleep, nutrition), and advance care planning started at the wellness visit

resource.title: Leonard Nimoy synthetic care plan
resource.description: Confirm COPD with post-bronchodilator spirometry in an 82-year-old former smoker who quit about thirty years ago, classify it by GOLD 2025 (grade 3, group B) with the CAT, mMRC, and exacerbation history, start a long-acting bronchodilator pair in an inhaler he can use well, check blood eosinophils and alpha-1 antitrypsin, assess oxygen need at rest and on exertion, enroll him in pulmonary rehabilitation, bring vaccines up to date, explain why he is not eligible for lung cancer screening, screen for comorbidities and mood, and begin advance care planning, on the CMID COPD schedule.
